verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents its own programmatic surfaces: a platform API catalog ("Discover Salesforce APIs"), an official CLI covering data queries, scratch-org creation, Apex tests and agent create/activate, and an official MCP server. A community user also praises the CLI and developer tooling. However, nothing in the pack shows that the API covers everything the UI can do, and no discoverable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity claim or coverage matrix, evidence that Sales Cloud features (forecasting, quoting, lead routing, dashboards) are reachable via API, a published machine-readable API spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
